title: Add chase target display and auto-win when target is reached

requirements.text: Show 2nd-innings chase context on the Live Scoring screen by computing and displaying the target from the 1st innings total (target = first innings runs + 1), along with remaining runs needed.

quotes: When 2nd batting team crosses the first batting teams score it's victory. Add target and winning details

acceptanceCriteria: When a match has 2 innings and the current innings is the second innings, LiveScoringPage displays a clearly labeled target (e.g., "Target: 151") computed as (first innings total runs + 1).
When a match is in the second innings, LiveScoringPage displays a clearly labeled remaining requirement (e.g., "Need 37 more runs to win").
All new user-facing labels/messages are in English.

requirements.text: Automatically detect a successful chase in the 2nd innings and immediately mark the match as won in the UI flow by preventing further ball recording and taking the scorer to the Match Summary screen when the 2nd innings total reaches or exceeds the target.

quotes: When 2nd batting team crosses the first batting teams score it's victory. Add target and winning details

acceptanceCriteria: During second innings scoring, as soon as the second innings total runs becomes >= target, the app shows an English success toast indicating the match is won and by which team.
After the chase is achieved, the Live Scoring controls no longer allow recording additional balls for that match (either disabled or blocked with an English message).
After the chase is achieved, the app navigates to the Match Summary screen for the match (without getting stuck on the Live Scoring page).

requirements.text: Add winning details to the Match Summary screen, including the target and a human-readable result line that includes win margin (by runs, wickets, or tie).

quotes: When 2nd batting team crosses the first batting teams score it's victory. Add target and winning details

acceptanceCriteria: MatchSummaryPage displays the target (first innings runs + 1) when two innings exist.

MatchSummaryPage displays an English result sentence matching the outcome: (a) if Team 2 chases successfully: "<Team2> won by <wickets remaining> wickets"; (b) if Team 1 defends successfully: "<Team1> won by <run margin> runs"; (c) if equal scores: "Match tied".
The winner heading on MatchSummaryPage remains correct for win/lose/tie outcomes and is consistent with the new result sentence.

constraints: Do not edit any files under frontend/src/components/ui (Shadcn UI components must be composed, not modified).
Do not edit frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts or frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts (immutable paths).
Keep the backend single-actor architecture (all Motoko logic in backend/main.mo); only add migration code if state schema upgrades are required.
nonGoals: Do not implement Duckworth-Lewis-Stern (DLS) or rain rules.
Do not add tournament/league points tables.
Do not add third-innings or multi-innings match formats beyond the existing two-innings flow.
